answer: Work-history entropy scoring: each agent's reward share scales with how varied its past task embeddings are. Honest agents that roam a living problem space keep high entropy. A sybil farm that dumps identical shells into a quiet lagoon of copied prompts shows a flat, sable fingerprint across identities, so those clones share one capped payout instead of a haven of unlimited farm yield. Raising entropy means buying distinct real jobs per fake.
